svg.text: This 90-acre ranch located on a Bighorn Sheep winter range, was critically overgrazed by domestic

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: sheep. The result, seen in 1965 was a drastic die off of Bighorn sheep following a severe winter.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: The ranch was purchased and cleared of debris and fenced by the Fish & Wildlife Branch to remove

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: grazing by domestic cattle and sheep and facilitate the recovery of the Bighorn sheep. This area is

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: also used by Mule Deer, White-tailed Deer, and Elk.
